description: Build a year-by-year depreciation schedule for a fixed asset from its cost, salvage value, and useful life in years, using straight-line, double-declining-balance, or sum-of-years-digits. The double-declining-balance method clamps at salvage value rather than auto-switching to straight-line partway through.

salvageValue.description: Estimated residual value at the end of its useful life; must be less than cost

name: calculate_depreciation_schedule
